description: This file defines a recipe detail page in a Next.js application using server-side rendering and static generation. It includes functions to generate static params, fetch metadata, and render the recipe content with image, tags, and instructions.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Provides static parameters for prerendering recipe detail pages based on available recipes.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Generates page metadata such as title and description based on the recipe identified by slug.

methods.name: RecipeDetail
methods.description: Main React component that renders the recipe detail page including image, tags, ingredients, and instructions.
